title: Add explicit campaign-rule management workflow
description:
Objective
Provide explicit player-facing management for campaign rulings and house rules: create, review, list/inspect, edit by supersession, and revoke.

Required behavior
Require player-provided or player-approved prose and an explicit kind. Show status, origin/provenance, effective position, and supersession/revocation history. Editing creates a new durable rule that supersedes the old identity rather than mutating historical semantic content. Ordinary creation applies prospectively unless invoked by the separate immediate-adjudication objection workflow.

Architecture and references
Use eshyra-jhpt.1 domain invariants and eshyra-jhpt.2 storage APIs. Preserve canonical history and ADR 0017 pack/campaign separation.

Non-goals
No arbitrary history rewrite; no direct editing of immutable rules-pack records; no automatic deterministic mechanic generation; no implicit ambiguity precedent; no DM-only unapproved rule creation; no persistence of ordinary contextual adjudications.
acceptance_criteria: Players can create ruling/house-rule prose, review and list active/history views, supersede through a new record, and revoke prospectively; confirmations expose effective timing and provenance; tests cover status transitions, deterministic ordering, invalid edits, cross-campaign isolation, and history preservation.
